title: CancelTimerGameTime - ScriptObject
content:
Member of: ScriptObject Script Cancels the specified game-time timer on this script. Does nothing if that timer has already expired or doesn't exist. Syntax: Function CancelTimerGameTime(int aiTimerID = 0) native Parameters: - aiTimerID: The ID of the game-time timer to cancel. The ID is unique per-script and will not conflict with real-time timers. Default: 0 Return Value: None. Examples: ; Cancel pending game-time timer 0 on this script CancelTimerGameTime()
; Cancel pending game-time timer 99 on this script CancelTimerGameTime(99) See Also: - ScriptObject Script - StartTimerGameTime - ScriptObject - OnTimerGameTime - ScriptObject
